village: N’oge gboo, n’otu obere obodo ọhịa gbara gburugburu,
kiko: e nwere otu mbe aha ya bụ Kiko, onye ihe niile na-agụ agụụ ịmata.
questions: A maara Kiko n’obodo ahụ dum maka ịjụ ajụjụ karịrị akarị.
questions.ask: Gịnị mere Kiko ji ajụ ọtụtụ ajụjụ otú ahụ?
moon: ihe mere ọnwa ji eso ndị njem,
moon.ask: Gịnị mere ọnwa ji eso ndị njem?
birds: ihe mere nnụnụ ji abụ abụ tupu anyanwụ awaa,
birds.ask: Gịnị mere nnụnụ ji abụ abụ tupu anyanwụ awaa?
baobab: na ihe mere akwụkwọ osisi baobab ochie ahụ ji adị ka ọ naghị adapụ adapụ.
mystery: Ma e nwere otu ihe omimi na-enweghị onye nwere ike ịkọwa ya.
night: Kwa abalị, n’ime ime ọhịa ahụ,
fire: a na-ahụ ọkụ ka ọ na-enwu n’okpuru otu osisi mgbe ochie.
never-out.ask: Gịnị mere ọkụ ahụ anaghị anyụ anyụ?
rain: Ọ naghị anyụ mgbe mmiri na-ezo.
wind: Ọ naghị anyụ mgbe ifufe na-efe.
storm: Ọ naghịdị anyụ mgbe oké ifufe na mmiri ozuzo kachasịa ike.
storm.ask: Olee otú ọkụ ga-esi na-enwu mgbe oké ifufe na mmiri ozuzo na-akpa ike?
name: Ndị obodo ahụ kpọrọ ya Ọkụ Ncheta.
name.ask: Gịnị mere e ji akpọ ya Ọkụ Ncheta?
memories: Ha kweere na ọ na-edebe ncheta onye ọ bụla bitụrụla ndụ n’ụwa.
memories.ask: Ọkụ ọ̀ pụrụ n’eziokwu idebe ncheta?
